# check-against: `CompareOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout check A --against B --json` (also the MCP tool `openreadout_check` with `against`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `check --against`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/check-against.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/check-against.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema check-against`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `identical` | `boolean` | yes | Nothing compared differs: metadata (unless skipped), geometry, channel names, physical sizes and planes (within the tolerance). The exit code is 0 when true, 1 when false. |
| `ours` | [`CompareSide`](#compareside) | yes | The first file. |
| `theirs` | [`CompareSide`](#compareside) | yes | The second file. |
| `metadata` | [`MetadataComparison`](#metadatacomparison) | yes | The normalized-metadata diff. |
| `images` | array of [`ImageComparison`](#imagecomparison) | yes | Geometry, channel-name and physical-size comparison per image index. |
| `planes` | [`PlaneComparison`](#planecomparison) | yes | The plane-by-plane comparison. |
| `notes` | array of `string` | yes | Caveats (e.g. formats that store different metadata for the same acquisition). |

## Types

### CompareSide

One file of the pair.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The file as given. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Its format id. |
| `images` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Number of images. |
| `tables` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Number of tables. |
| `traces` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Number of traces. |

### MetadataComparison

The normalized-metadata diff.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compared` | `boolean` | yes | False with `--no-metadata`. |
| `equal` | `boolean` | yes | True when no difference was found. |
| `ignored` | array of `string` | yes | Pointers left out (defaults plus `--ignore`); `extra` objects are also left out unless `include_extra`. |
| `include_extra` | `boolean` | yes | Whether `extra` objects were compared. |
| `difference_count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Total number of differences (the list holds at most 1000). |
| `differences` | array of [`Difference`](#difference) | yes | The differences, at most 1000. |

### Difference

A value that differs, at an RFC 6901 JSON pointer into `info --json` `data`.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pointer` | `string` | yes | RFC 6901 JSON pointer to the value, e.g. `/images/0/physical_size/x`. |
| `ours` | any JSON |  | Value in the first file; absent when the first file lacks the field. |
| `theirs` | any JSON |  | Value in the second file; absent when the second file lacks the field. |

### ImageComparison

One image index present in either file.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Image index. |
| `ours` | [`Geometry`](#geometry) or `null` |  | Absent when the first file has no image with this index. |
| `theirs` | [`Geometry`](#geometry) or `null` |  | Absent when the second file has no image with this index. |
| `geometry_equal` | `boolean` | yes | Both files have the image and their geometries agree. |
| `channel_names_equal` | `boolean` | yes | Channel names agree. |
| `ours_channels` | array of `string` or `null` | yes | Channel names of the first file (listed only when they differ). |
| `theirs_channels` | array of `string` or `null` | yes | Channel names of the second file (listed only when they differ). |
| `physical_size_equal` | `boolean` | yes | Physical sizes agree to a relative 1e-6 (both absent counts as equal). |
| `ours_physical_size` | [`PhysicalSize`](#physicalsize) or `null` |  | Physical pixel size in the first file (listed only when the sizes differ). |
| `theirs_physical_size` | [`PhysicalSize`](#physicalsize) or `null` |  | Physical pixel size in the second file (listed only when the sizes differ). |

### Geometry

Geometry of one image.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size_x` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Width in pixels. |

### PixelType

Sample type of one channel value. Names follow OME-XML `PixelType` values.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"int8"` | Signed 8-bit integer. |
| `"int16"` | Signed 16-bit integer. |
| `"int32"` | Signed 32-bit integer. |
| `"uint8"` | Unsigned 8-bit integer. |
| `"uint16"` | Unsigned 16-bit integer (the usual microscope camera output). |
| `"uint32"` | Unsigned 32-bit integer. |
| `"float"` | 32-bit IEEE 754 floating point. |
| `"double"` | 64-bit IEEE 754 floating point. |
| `"int64"` | Signed 64-bit integer. |
| `"uint64"` | Unsigned 64-bit integer. |
| `"complex"` | Complex number of two 32-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `complex`. |
| `"double-complex"` | Complex number of two 64-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `double-complex`. |

### PhysicalSize

Physical pixel size in micrometres (the OME default unit). Every present value is > 0.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Pixel width in µm (the distance between neighbouring columns). |
| `y` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Pixel height in µm (the distance between neighbouring rows). |
| `z` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Spacing between Z planes (focal slices) in µm. |
| `unit` | `string` | yes | Always `µm` in this schema version. |

### PlaneComparison

Plane-by-plane comparison.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compared` | `boolean` | yes | False with `--no-pixels`. |
| `tolerance` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | The `--tolerance` used, if any. |
| `planes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Planes read from both files. |
| `identical` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Planes with identical xxh3-128. |
| `within_tolerance` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Planes that differ but within the tolerance. |
| `mismatched` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Planes that differ beyond the tolerance (or at all, without one). |
| `skipped_images` | array of `integer` (uint32) | yes | Image indices not compared plane by plane (missing on one side or geometry differs). |
| `mismatches` | array of [`PlaneMismatch`](#planemismatch) | yes | At most 1000 entries, in plane order. |

### PlaneMismatch

A plane that differs.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Image index. |
| `c` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channel index. |
| `z` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Z index. |
| `t` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Time index. |
| `ours_xxh3` | `string` | yes | xxh3-128 of the plane in the first file. |
| `theirs_xxh3` | `string` | yes | xxh3-128 of the plane in the second file. |
| `differing_samples` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Samples that differ (absent when the planes' shapes differ). |
| `max_abs_diff` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Largest absolute difference between corresponding samples. |
| `within_tolerance` | `boolean` | yes | With a tolerance: whether `max_abs_diff` is within it (then the plane counts as equal). |
| `note` | `string` or `null` |  | Why the samples could not be compared (e.g. the plane shapes differ). |
